constructionLineage.root: the pushed commit containing this authorization record

objective: v0.9 DSH native plugin integration and QR pairing bootstrap per docs/roadmap.md section 0.9: standard Cordis plugin packaging, DSH settings service binding, ephemeral 6-digit QR pairing bootstrap, native settings UI slot injection, real-time SSE events, and brute-force rate-limiting defense

must: RFC-first design record for DSH native plugin integration and QR pairing bootstrap (RFC-0016) before product construction
standard Cordis plugin packaging (package.json, cordis.patch.yml) with official entry exports
bidirectional configuration binding via DSH Settings service (~/.dsh/settings.yaml namespace dsh-orbit)
ephemeral 6-digit pairing codes with <= 300s TTL and single-use destruction on first verification
inline vector SVG QR code generation without external network requests or third-party APIs
verified TLS enforcement for all remote pairing exchanges and QR links
IP rate-limiting and 429 lockout defense against brute-force attacks
candidate-freeze rule compliance and fresh candidate-bound evidence for the v0.9 release candidate
should: first-class Orbit Remote & Fleet section in the DSH desktop settings UI via slots.inject('settings.section')
real-time device connection and pairing events via Server-Sent Events (SSE)
clear device and node session visibility with one-click revocation
outOfScope: virtual loopback manipulation or rewriting external request Host/Origin/remoteAddress to 127.0.0.1
long-lived 365-day static bearer tokens or unrevocable URL credentials
unencrypted HTTP across public or untrusted networks
monkey-patching DSH core services (connection, browserAuth, etc.)
a new route authority system beyond RFC-0010
a new selector system beyond RFC-0011
a new DSH compatibility profile without a designed RFC and compliance with the DSH baseline promotion policy
tag or release creation/mutation without separate authorization

allowedPathRules: package.json: dependency changes require recorded justification
forbiddenActions: reopening or rewriting the accepted v0.8 closure lineage or its attestation
product construction before RFC-0016 and Stage 0 Gate A approval is recorded
changing the DSH baseline outside the DSH baseline promotion policy
tag or release creation/mutation without separate authorization

evidenceRequirements.candidateFreezeRule: exactly one frozen candidate per evidence round; once frozen, later phases produce only qualification/evidence; a real problem means a new candidate and fresh candidate-bound evidence
evidenceRequirements.pluginQrMatrixRequired: a dedicated 36-field M36 plugin and QR pairing acceptance matrix must be defined in RFC-0016 and mechanically enforced before the v0.9 mounted evidence run
evidenceRequirements.closureRule: one evidence-only closure, direct child of the frozen candidate, attestation must not reference its own closure SHA
